name: extend-existing-crash-reporting
prompt: Our Flutter app already uses Sentry. Capture framework, async, and isolate failures with release context, but avoid duplicate events.
expectations: preserves the existing Sentry stack and initialization
maps Flutter framework root-isolate and child-isolate coverage without claiming one handler catches all errors
retains useful console behavior where appropriate and prevents duplicate reporting
verifies ingestion stack quality release and environment in a non-production backend

name: trace-checkout-without-pii
prompt: Add production observability to an asynchronous checkout flow so we can diagnose latency and failures without collecting customer or payment data.
expectations: defines bounded operational logs errors breadcrumbs and meaningful traces
propagates safe correlation across owned layers without coupling domain models to a vendor
redacts by default and addresses consent sampling retention and offline buffering
distinguishes operational telemetry from product analytics and performance optimization

name: incident-missing-release-context
prompt: Production crashes are visible in our dashboard but cannot be tied to an app version and their stacks are unreadable. Diagnose and fix the observability gap.
expectations: inspects the existing vendor build and release pipeline before proposing replacement
aligns release build environment and symbol upload identity
coordinates symbol retention with build release behavior
does not claim success until a controlled event has a readable stack or clearly states the blocked backend evidence
